---
title: "About"
subtitle: "A regional collective of infectious disease modellers."
page-layout: article
---

MIDSEA is a network of early-career and senior researchers building
**transparent, regionally-grounded mathematical models** of the infectious
diseases that shape public health across South East Asia — from dengue and
malaria to emerging zoonoses and AMR.

We connect modellers with public health agencies, share code and data, train
the next generation, and coordinate rapid responses when outbreaks cross
borders.
